newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: G-10 central banks sees stable oil markets.
newsitem.headline: G-10 central banks sees stable oil markets.

text.p: Bundesbank President Hans Tietmeyer said Group of 10 central bank governors saw a good chance for quiet and stable oil markets over the next 12 months.
"Concerning oil markets...there is a good chance for a quiet and stable development during the next 12 months," Tietmeyer told reporters.
Tietmeyer was speaking after the monthly meeting of G-10 central bank governors, of which he is chairman, at the Basle-based Bank for International Settlements.
Tietmeyer said the G-10 forecast of stable oil markets was based on both demand and supply developments.
"And of course this will have a positive effect not only on the world economy but also the region of the Middle East," he said.
